topic: Food trucks, concession carts and mobile bars
summary: Food trucks are typically 18 to 30 ft long, 8 to 9 ft wide and 10 to 12 ft tall (about 6 x 2.6 x 3.4 m). Plan a level, firm, paved surface (slopes under 2 percent), 15 ft from building entrances, 10 ft from tents, a 4 to 6 ft service zone at the order window and 200 to 400 sq ft for the queue; most run their own generator at about 60 to 75 dB. Trailers run 8 to 24 ft long, 7 to 8.5 ft wide. A cotton candy cart is about 42 x 28 x 54 in (1.07 x 0.71 x 1.37 m) and holds a machine sold separately; a commercial popcorn and floss cart has a 20 x 48 in base. Mobile bar and charcuterie carts on locking wheels run about 30 x 53 in (0.76 x 1.35 m) with a flat top and shelf, or a slim 11 in deep x 2 ft wide x 3.5 ft high (0.28 x 0.61 x 1.07 m) three-tier bar cart. Keep food carts in shade in summer.
